2.  The petitioner complains that the private respondents/son and daughter-in-law are torturing the petitioner and his wife and are compelling them to transfer the property in their favour.
3. Jagacha Police Station has registered FIR No. 88 of 2022 on the basis of the petitioner's complaint.
Investigation has been completed and Charge Sheet No. 113 of 2022 dated 10.03.2022 has been filed.

4. The private respondent/daughter-in-law is stated to have filed a complaint against the petitioner,
inter alia, under Section 498A of the IPC and the provisions of the D. V. Act.
5. This Court is of the view that the private respondents should not disturb the petitioner in any way.
6. The learned counsel for the private respondents undertakes before this Court not to disturb the petitioner in any way.

10. The writ petition is thus disposed of.
